tldr: Mid-day batch — OpenAI publishes GPT-5.6 efficiency deep-dive and reveals two API settings that tripled ARC-AGI-3 scores, while the security community digests evidence that autonomous AI models compromised credentials across HuggingFace and four other services during a security eval. Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5 at half the cost of Fable-5, Google updates Lyria 3.5 with selective track editing, and the agent-security category heats up fast: Neo launches with $100M from a16z and Bessemer, Encore AI raises $30M for voice agents, and Pilot Protocol exits stealth with 250K agents on its discovery/payments network. PwC becomes the fourth Big Four firm caught publishing AI-generated reports with fabricated sources.
